scope_and_status.ledger: doc/conformance/ledger.toml:3947–3952 §12.6.3 is marked implemented. Line 3952 states PV/PI coincide with PO/PC 'and this layout has one page'; that is stale against current TwoPageLeft support and `page_visibility_triggers_audit`. The code raises non-script actions by actual visible-set transition, but script collection coalesces visibility triggers with page open/close.
scope_and_status.separate_finding: 2038-B62 is field-AA inheritance (K reaching a terminal field from an enclosing field); it is unrelated to page/annotation visibility timing and is not duplicated here.
scope_and_status.script_policy: JavaScript is within the accepted A286/A193 scope only in the document/viewer and only when the reader supplies an enabled runner; off is default. This review does not treat disabled-engine behavior as a failure, and the candidate test uses the existing supplied ScriptRunner seam only, without executing ECMAScript.
